summary: FRONTEND-ONLY E2E testing of new AgentConfigModal ('Configurar Robô' popup) on the Atendimento IA banner. All 9 specified assertions PASSED. Button opens the modal, all 5 sections (personality/model/whatsapp/tools/autoreply) render with their expected data-testids; Isabella selected by default with prefilled fields; model section loads 6 options; WhatsApp section shows status CONECTADO with logout button (instance is connected); Tools section shows 6 tools, toggling triggers dirty footer + enables Save; Auto-reply section shows card/status/active checkbox/toggle; new agent flow creates 'Bot Teste E2E' (success flash visible), new row appears in sidebar, deletion via window.confirm works (cleanup OK), modal closes and banner stays visible (regression OK).

issues: Cosmetic: avatar initial letter renders glued to the agent name in compact width (e.g. 'BBot Teste E2E', 'IIsabella') because the 30x30 avatar and the name share the same line without a visual gap when the row text is concatenated via textContent — visual rendering itself is fine (separate elements), but consider adding an explicit space if used in screen readers/snapshots.

critical_code_review_comments: AgentConfigModal.js (~862 lines) is on the edge of the 700-line guideline — consider splitting each Section component into its own file (PersonalitySection, ModelSection, WhatsAppSection, ToolsSection, AutoReplySection) for maintainability.
WhatsAppSection useEffect polls every 3s/8s and depends on `status` — every status change re-creates the interval. Functional but slightly wasteful; consider single ref-based interval.

BLANK_AGENT initial_message contains an emoji and a Portuguese string; fine, but value isn't applied to a brand-new agent because `startNew` overrides with empty placeholder behaviour. Currently it does spread BLANK_AGENT so initial_message default works — OK.
No optimistic UI for delete: relies on reload(). Acceptable.
All interactive elements DO have data-testid coverage — good.
seed_data_creation: Created 'Bot Teste E2E' agent during test, deleted via UI confirm dialog. DB returned to baseline (only 'Isabella' agent remaining).
